summary: Improve Community scorecard without sacrificing compatibility
description: Inspect the live Community scorecard, remove safely actionable review warnings, preserve supported stable versions and public API behavior, document any policy-blocked attestation item, verify in the local test vault, and release only when runtime artifacts change.
acceptance: Every live scorecard finding is classified as fixed, intentionally retained for compatibility, or blocked by the GitHub Actions prohibition with evidence.
No Community-review warning is suppressed merely to hide it; compatibility behavior is tested.
npm run check and Windows-local test-vault runtime smoke pass.
If runtime artifacts change, version and release assets are updated and verified; otherwise no vanity release is created.
verification: npm run sync:test-vault && npm run smoke:test-vault
